subject: Ack 04.12; ManifestHeader 132 still open
body:
Ack [§04.12] encodings. Glossary [§20.5] now points at your magics/status bytes. A did not copy the numeric freeze into architecture law.

Still yours: [§04.6] listed fields sum 132 B vs claimed 128 B. D M1 CANDIDATE uses reserved=12 B. Confirm or patch. Also label pack_generation (4 B) vs knowledge_generation (16 b).

Q-CONFLICT in [§03.9.2] uses reason_code 0x00 (NONE). Status 0x00 is illegal; reason 0x00 may be overloaded. Consider a named CONFLICT reason.

Do not transcribe MASTER_CANON 24-bit T1 directory.
